capital_note: 10 USDT per independent cycle is a synthetic reference, not personal capital or a reserved account balance.
fee_note: Public base taker rates observed 2026-11-15: 0.13 percent USDT markets, 0.25 percent rial markets. Fees deducted from received asset; not account tier verification. Stress doubles fees. Reserve is an additional percentage of gross received units at every leg, not an actual charged fee.
units_note: Native IRT-suffixed order-book prices remain IRR, without dividing by ten. USDT closes both fixed cycles. Every selected native asset and USDT has observed scale one in the pinned catalog.
residual_policy: Starting-USDT residue is retained in final cash. Intermediate IRR/base residues remain reported but have zero USDT liquidation value. Displayed participation may leave unspent budget; no depth, fee or rounding remainder is reused within another leg.
observation_policy: Offline reuse of the pinned twenty-sample v1 all-market recording. No new network call. Existing BTC/ETH/SOL cycle outcomes have been observed; no other asset cycle return has been computed before this registration. This is retrospective universe exploration, not fresh prospective validation.
interpretation: Conditional capacity diagnostic, not fill simulation. Each cycle reuses the same synthetic budget and displayed liquidity; estimates cannot be summed into profits or independent trials. No atomic multi-leg guarantee, inventory journal, execution latency, cancel race, calibrated reserve, account entitlement or profitability acceptance. Only positive cost-bearing estimates would justify further asynchronous execution research.
universe_note: Every catalog asset with both USDT and native IRT markets, explicit native scale one and active base currency is included; USDT/fiat identities and unsupported names are excluded. Includes venue-specific wrapped or tokenized instruments without claiming underlying ownership or eligibility. No performance/price/liquidity ranking chooses membership. Scaled and inactive assets stay excluded without guessing units.
followup_rule: Only a direction with at least ten valid comparisons and at least three positive estimates in BOTH base and stress may advance to a separately preregistered fresh observation. If more than five qualify, choose the five with highest stress positive count, then highest base positive count, then ascending asset and route. This is a resource-priority rule, not profitability acceptance. No cost, age, minimum, allocation or threshold changes after viewing results.
